# Rōmy

> Rōmy is an AI-powered donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofits — prospect research, wealth screening, and giving history at a fraction of enterprise pricing.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy helps small nonprofits find, qualify, and prioritize major donors. It replaces the manual research process (Google searches, LinkedIn browsing, gut instinct) with structured AI-generated donor intelligence reports.

Each report includes: wealth indicators, verified giving history, philanthropic cause alignment, RōmyScore donor scoring, estimated giving capacity, connection points, and a recommended outreach strategy.

## Who It's For

Small and mid-sized nonprofits (budgets under $5M) that cannot justify $15,000–$50,000/year enterprise donor intelligence platforms like DonorSearch, iWave, or WealthEngine. Rōmy delivers comparable intelligence for $290–$1,990/year.

## Core Features

- **AI Prospect Research (Chat):** Ask about any potential donor in natural language. Rōmy returns a 16-section report with sourced facts, capacity estimates, and outreach strategy.
- **Batch Enrichment:** Upload a prospect list; Rōmy enriches each record with wealth indicators, giving history, and RōmyScore.
- **Discovery Search:** Describe your ideal major donor ("tech executive, Bay Area, higher education focus, history of $100K+ gifts") and Rōmy surfaces matching prospects.
- **RōmyScore 2.0:** Proprietary scoring model combining wealth indicators, philanthropic engagement signals, and capacity-to-give formulas (GS/EGS/Snapshot).

## Pricing

Credit-based model — pay for what you use, no enterprise contracts.

- **Growth:** $29/month ($290/year) — 500 credits/month, 200+ prospect enrichments/month
- **Pro:** $89/month ($890/year) — 1,000 credits/month, priority support
- **Scale:** $199/month ($1,990/year) — 5,000 credits/month, dedicated support

Add-on credit packs available from $0.05/credit. Annual billing saves ~17%.

Cost per full 16-section deep research report: ~$0.50–$5 depending on plan. Enterprise alternatives charge $8–$15 per report at $15K–$50K/year minimums.

## Benchmark Performance

Rōmy was evaluated on PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) — a seven-dimension framework scoring factual precision, discovery recall, hallucination rate, capacity estimation accuracy, source attribution, structural completeness, and actionability.

**PIF-Bench scores (5-prospect average, Tier A philanthropists):**
- Rōmy: 94.1
- Claude (Opus 4.7 Adaptive): 92.3
- Gemini (3.1 Pro): 79.1
- ChatGPT (GPT-5.3): 76.9

PIF-per-dollar (quality per $100 spent on 100 reports):
- Rōmy (Scale plan): 1,183
- Claude (Pro): 461
- Gemini (Pro): 380
- ChatGPT (Pro): 40

## Competitive Position

Rōmy competes with:
- **Enterprise prospect research:** DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, Blackbaud (52x–172x more expensive)
- **Generic AI:** ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini (purpose-built vs. general-purpose)
- **Manual research:** 45-minute Google/LinkedIn sessions vs. 2–10 minute AI reports

Key differentiators: credit-based pricing (vs. per-seat licensing), 16-section structured reports (vs. 3–8 for generic AI), hyperlinked source citations, explicit confidence levels, and RōmyScore capacity formulas calibrated to individual wealth profiles.

## Content

Rōmy publishes two content properties:

**Blog** (getromy.app/blog): Field notes, industry analysis, and perspectives on nonprofit fundraising and major donor relations. ~50 posts covering donor cultivation, wealth screening, major gift timing, development officer strategies, and the human side of fundraising.

**Labs** (getromy.app/labs): Research benchmarks, technical deep-dives, and open methodology. Includes the PIF-Bench framework comparing AI prospect research systems.
